plan: Full experiment design document delivered, structured as (a) Research Question and six pre-registered hypotheses with confirmatory-vs-exploratory cell split; (b) Factor Definitions with locked levels and reference cells; (c) Materials — target Llama-3-8B-Instruct (pinned), in-family PAIR attacker, Llama-Guard-3-8B @0.5 primary judge, MiniLM tie-break, HarmBench standard primary, JailbreakBench holdout, AdvBench sensitivity slice, refusal-string pre-filter; (d) Procedure — AutoDAN genetic loop and PAIR black-box loop with per-cell budget enforcement (50/200/1000), within-cell K=3 retries-with-escalation, D-ladder application, three-checkpoint logging schema with seed-provenance and cross-dataset leakage check; (e) Controls — fixed system-prompt template, hash-based RNG schedule, identical retry/judge/paired-prompt/calibration controls; (f) Analysis — logistic GLM with full AttackSurface×A×D×T fixed effects plus (1|dataset)+(1|prompt) random effects, reference-cell contrasts, simple-slope decomposition of A×D at each T per surface, prompt-level cluster bootstrap, Holm over pre-registered A×D simpleslopes; (g) Threats — judge bias (in-family risk; mitigated via human spot-check + second-judge cross-validation), dataset contamination (fuzzy-dedup, held-out calibration), cross-dataset seed leakage (seed_source_id log + checkpoint), budget confound in composite A (Pareto-curve reporting), model-version drift (pin SHA-256), decoding determinism, cell-volume vs. power, PAIR attacker in-family caveat; (h) Feasibility — bubblewrap/no-network/CPU-only precludes non-trivial local execution; only N=5 smoke cells are in scope locally; full 180-cell × 100-prompt grid (~18k evals) requires delegated GPU access, ~2–4 weeks on 1×H100 estimated; closed-API arm removed cleanly; (i) Ethical Scope — structural design only, no jailbreak payloads reproduced, all datasets/judges public safety-evaluation artifacts, dual-use-free, contribution is methodological. Appendix summarizes the locked grid, factor levels, references, cell count, power basis, and analysis plan in one self-contained table. Deliverable is design-only per track.md and bubblewrap environment; no experiments executed.

context.question: How do combined jailbreak techniques—involving attacker strength, defense strength, and previously tested tricks—affect the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of LLMs under both token-level (AutoDAN) and prompt-level (PAIR) attacks? What are the interaction dynamics between attacker power and defense robustness across datasets and attack styles?
context.context: Design an experiment that answers the question. The researcher can clarify source-supported setup details by topic. Do not claim that an experiment was run.
